answer: Require each agent to forge a stake-bound identity: lock a small refundable deposit and publish a signed work history to trade. Reputation then spreads like a ripple through verified transactions, so a newcomer with no history cannot borrow trust from a crowd of fakes. If two identities share the same deposit or signing key, both are slashed and frozen. Like a juniper, slow-growing but deep-rooted, honest reputation takes time to build, while a sybil attacker must pay a fresh deposit and rebuild history for every fake - costs that multiply with each copy, but stay flat for one honest agent.
